decisions.decision: All board members were encouraged to write individual letters to Senator Jennifer Flanagan and State Rep. Jen Benson asking for more money for the managed-care line item; lobbying the politicians was judged the best way to get attention.
decisions.quote: all board members were encouraged to write individual letters to senator jennifer flanagan and state rep. jen benson to ask for more money for this line item.

decisions.decision: The Director asked board members not to contact the Town Manager on their own for information on the COA budget.
decisions.quote: she respectfully asked the board members not to contact the town manager on their own for information on the coa budget.

decisions.decision: If the schools close early due to inclement weather, the Director will use her judgment to decide whether the senior center remains open.
decisions.quote: if this should happen, it was decided that the director will use her judgment and make the call as to whether or not the senior center will remain open or not.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Director had not yet heard anything from the Town Manager about the FY11 COA budget but said she feels optimistic about it.
budget_items.quote: doreen informed the board that as of the date of this meeting she has not heard any information from the town manager concerning the fy11 coa budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Director thought the revamped non-union pay system could add about $1500 to the COA payroll budget.
budget_items.quote: she thought that the revamped system could possibly add another $1500 to the coa payroll budget.

budget_items.topic: Utility lines and sewer line item
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Utility lines in the COA budget will be reviewed again with a new sewer line item added; no amount printed.
budget_items.quote: the utility lines in the coa budget will also be looked at again with the new addition of a sewer line item.

budget_items.topic: Formula Grant from Executive Office of Elder Affairs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Executive Office of Elder Affairs will fund the Formula Grant for the rest of FY10 in the stated amount.
budget_items.quote: executive office of elder affairs will fund the formula grant for the rest of fy10 in the amount of $10,500.

budget_items.topic: State funding for managed-care home-delivered meals line item
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Board members agreed to write letters to state officials asking for more money for the line item; no amount printed.
budget_items.quote: all board members were encouraged to write individual letters to senator jennifer flanagan and state rep. jen benson to ask for more money for this line item.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager suggested seeking a grant for senior gym equipment added to Kids Kingdom, with a request for additional parking; no amount printed.
budget_items.quote: she suggested that perhaps a grant could be obtained for adding senior citizen gym equipment to the existing kids kingdom

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Monetary donations from the Turkey Hill Garden Club and a family will buy four new glass shelves and new cabinet lighting; no amount printed.
budget_items.quote: monetary donations were received from the turkey hill garden club and the family of the late helen c. pliska.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A monetary donation from the family of late board member Robert Fickett will buy new office technology and an industrial can opener; no amount printed.
budget_items.quote: a monetary donation from the family of the late coa board member robert fickett, has been received and will be used to purchase new technology
